argv.notes: The native composition is one long-lived leader plus a leader-attached ACP controller and TUI.

acp.notes: Strict JSON-RPC 2.0 NDJSON over stdio. Standard session/update and xAI extension methods are separate observable rails.

session-log.notes: Append-only GROK_HOME/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>/updates.jsonl records with timestamp, method, and params.

session-state.notes: Replace-in-place signals.json and summary.json beside updates.jsonl.

leader.notes: Coordination socket owned by grok agent leader; it is topology, not a normalized semantic event source.

terminal.notes: Native leader-attached TUI. Semantics are derived from ACP and persisted files, never terminal text.
